[Intro]
[Bb]
[Eb]
[Bb]
[Eb]

[Verse 1]
[Bbadd11]Who breaks the power
of sin and darkness?
[Eb5]Whose love is mighty
and so much stronger?
[Gm/D]The King of Glory,
[F11]the King above all kings,
[Eb5]
ooh
[Bbadd11]Who shakes the whole earth
with holy thunder
[Eb5]And leaves us breathless
in awe and wonder?
[Gm/D]The King of Glory,
[F11]the King above all kings
[Eb5]
This is amazing grace

[Chorus]
[Bbadd11]
This is unfailing love
[Eb5]
That You would take my place
[Gm/D]
That You would bear my cross
[F11]
You laid down Your life
[Bbadd11]
That I would be set
[Eb5]free
Oh,
[Gm/D]Jesus, I sing for
All that You've done for me

[Interlude]
[Bb]
[Eb]

[Verse 2]
[Bbadd11]Who brings our chaos
back into order?
[Eb5]Who makes the orphan
a son and daughter?
[Eb5]The King of Glory,
[Gm/D]the King of Glory
[Bbadd11]Who rules the nations
with truth and justice,
[Eb5]Shines like the sun in
all of its brilliance?
[Gm/D]The King of Glory,
[F11]the King above all kings
[Eb5]Oh,
this is amazing grace

[Chorus]
[Bbadd11]
This is unfailing love
[Eb5]
That You would take my place
[Gm/D]
That You would bear my cross
[F11]
You laid down Your life
[Bbadd11]
That I would be set
[Eb5]free
Oh,

[F11]All that You've done for me
[Bbadd11]

[Bridge]

[Eb5]Worthy is the King who con-
quered the grave
